name: minecraft-seed-tools
description: Chunkbase-style Minecraft Seed Map and Seed Finder (Java + Bedrock) with a shared WASM/native generation engine

scripts.gen:golden: cmake -S . -B build/native >/dev/null && cmake --build build/native --target golden_dump >/dev/null && ./build/native/golden_dump tests/golden/worlds.bin
scripts.build:aar: cd bindings/android/aar && JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/jdk} ./gradlew :seedmaps:assembleRelease :app:assembleDebug -q && cd ../.. && mkdir -p bindings/android/dist/aar && cp bindings/android/aar/seedmaps/build/outputs/aar/seedmaps-release.aar bindings/android/dist/aar/seedmaps-release.aar
scripts.test: npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run build:wasm && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:finder && npm run test:versions && npm run test:golden && npm run test:browser && npm run test:interface && npm run test:android && npm run test:android-device && npm run test:swift && npm run test:csharp
